recognize_zh: 骨髓切片免疫染色中，大量小至中型淋巴樣細胞呈細胞膜陽性，成片或間質性分布於脂肪空泡之間，與藍色未染色的造血細胞交錯；圖上未標示抗體，推測為 T 細胞標記，用於呈現 T-PLL 的骨髓浸潤程度。
features: Numerous small to medium lymphoid cells with membranous brown staining
Interstitial to sheet-like infiltrate between adipocytes
Interspersed unstained residual hematopoietic cells with blue nuclei
Positive cells account for a large proportion of marrow cellularity
Specific antibody not indicated in the image
describe_en: Immunohistochemical stain of a bone marrow core biopsy shows an extensive interstitial to sheet-like infiltrate of small to medium lymphoid cells with membranous staining, interspersed among fat spaces and unstained residual hematopoietic cells. The antibody is not labeled on the image; the membranous pattern would fit a T-cell marker such as CD3, CD7 or CD52. In the context of T-prolymphocytic leukemia, the stain highlights substantial marrow involvement; TCL1 immunostaining can confirm the neoplastic population.

ddx.vs: Reactive T cells are scattered and polyclonal without aberrant antigen loss or TCL1 expression.
T-LGL shows subtle intrasinusoidal linear CD8+/TIA-1+/granzyme B+ cells rather than dense interstitial sheets.
CLL forms nodular/interstitial infiltrates of CD20+/CD5+/LEF1+ B cells.
